steps.name: build-new-debug-APK-and-recount-native-controls
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "APP_SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'CAPACITOR_SYNC_ANDROID'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
test -d "$SDK"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
echo 'GRADLE_DEBUG_APK'
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK" | tr -d ' ')"
echo 'PRODUCTION_NATIVE_CENSUS'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
n={'button':0,'input':0,'select':0,'textarea':0};fs=set()
for p in Path('apps/mobile/src').rglob('*.tsx'):
 if re.search(r'\.(test|spec)\.tsx$',p.name):continue
 t=p.read_text()
 for tag in n:
  count=len(re.findall(r'<'+tag+r'\b',t))
  n[tag]+=count
  if count:fs.add(str(p))
print('NATIVE_CONTROLS',n,'FILES',len(fs),'TOTAL',sum(n.values()))
PY
echo 'FINAL_TREE';git status --short
